error.message: The loop through MIX1, HTXR2, SPLIT3 did not converge in 2 iterations: the tear stream still changes by 1.67e-1 (relative) per iteration; the tolerance is 1e-12. What usually helps: a purge or a smaller recycle fraction (a recycle with no way out keeps growing), a guess for the tear stream (S7) close to the answer, another tear stream, another convergence method, or more iterations.
